Synopsis:
The dialogue with saved Vanra, she was either vomitted out or carved from the hag by players.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_VanraSaved.json: Off‑screen the player has already recovered Vanra from a hag—either she was vomited out or physically carved free—and returned the child to her mother, Lora, at their home/inn (the Blushing Mermaid). Vanra is physically present but severely traumatized and largely catatonic, only able to mumble “Mummy” with glazed eyes. Lora is distraught, wracked with guilt, and trying to comfort her while the player (and possibly companions) stand nearby after confronting the hag or her disguise. That state explains Vanra’s broken, repetitive lines and why player replies swing between soft reassurance and impatient frustration.
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_SavingVanra.json: Player interacted with the knocked out hag after combat with her. Player can cut Vanra out of the hag and save her.
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_VomitsOutVanra_Hag.json: If Marrow of Mercy is thrown in the burning Circle of Pearls while Vanra is still alive inside the hag, the hag will vomit her out in this dialogue
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_Hag_AfterDeal.json: Hag dialogue for the case when players killed Lora for her and the hag promised to help them in the finale.
- LOW_HagSurvivors_DisguisedJatloInstaDied.json: Dialog between survivors gathered around a dead hag spy, Jatlo. Happens when the hag is killed before players have triggered combat with the spy.Mayrina and Mask of Regret are optional speakers.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Vanra: Mmm... Mmmm... || [context] CinematicNodeContext: eyes glazed over, like she doesn't see the player. Struggling to speak.NodeContext: traumatised, struggling to speak - trying to say 'mummy' (node 3)
- Player: You're safe now - the hag can't hurt you any more. (node 4)

Sample 2:
- Vanra: Mmm... Mmmm... || [context] CinematicNodeContext: eyes glazed over, like she doesn't see the player. Struggling to speak.NodeContext: traumatised, struggling to speak - trying to say 'mummy' (node 3)
- Player: Stop mumbling! (node 6)
